design_gotchas.title: Pin 10 (FB) MUST Be Connected Directly to VOUT on Fixed 3.3 V TPS63001
design_gotchas.detail: TPS63001 uses an internal feedback divider (1 MOhm FB input impedance) that requires Pin 10 (FB) to be routed directly to VOUT (Pin 1) at the output capacitor. Leaving FB floating or tying it to GND breaks voltage regulation.

design_gotchas.title: Recommended 100 Ohm + 0.1 uF RC Filter on VINA (Pin 8) Prevents Control Noise Faults
design_gotchas.detail: Page 1 Typical Application Schematic places a 100 Ohm resistor and 0.1 uF ceramic capacitor between VIN and VINA (Pin 8) to shield the internal analog control stage from 1.5 MHz power-stage switching transients. Always decouple VINA closely to GND (Pin 9).

design_gotchas.title: 1.9 V Startup Threshold and 800 mA Boost-Mode Ceiling vs 1200 mA Buck Rating
design_gotchas.detail: Although TPS63001 operates down to 1.8 V once running, guaranteed startup requires >= 1.9 V on VIN. Furthermore, maximum 3.3 V load current drops from 1200 mA (step-down, VIN >= 3.6 V) to 800 mA in boost mode (VIN > 2.4 V) and lower near 1.8 V.

design_gotchas.title: Incompatible VSON-10 (DRC) Package vs Larger VSON-14 TPS63020DSJR
design_gotchas.detail: TPS63001DRCR uses a 3 mm x 3 mm 10-pin VSON (DRC) without a PG pin, whereas TPS63020DSJR uses a 3 mm x 4 mm 14-pin VSON (DSJ) with PG and 4 A switches. Any migration between the two requires full PCB layout redesign.

typical_use_cases: Single-cell Li-Ion (2.5 V to 4.2 V) or 2-3 cell NiMH/alkaline battery regulated to fixed 3.3 V up to 1.2 A
Portable audio players, smart wearables, and personal medical monitors needing < 50 uA Iq and load disconnect
Compact 3 mm x 3 mm VSON-10 fixed 3.3 V buck-boost rail with optional external clock synchronization
engineering_summary: The TPS63001DRCR is a fixed 3.3 V, 4-switch synchronous buck-boost converter in a compact 3 mm x 3 mm 10-pin VSON (DRC) package with a PGND exposed thermal pad (RthetaJA = 46.8°C/W). Operating from 1.8 V to 5.5 V (1.9 V startup) at 1.25-1.5 MHz with 41 uA total typical Iq and 1.8 A typical switch current limit, it delivers up to 1200 mA in buck mode and 800 mA in boost mode (VIN > 2.4 V) with true load disconnect. Remember to wire FB (Pin 10) directly to VOUT and include the 100 Ohm / 0.1 uF VINA RC filter; verify full derating in the official TI datasheet before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.3 confirmed DRC 10-pin VSON Top View pinout (1=VOUT, 2=L2, 3=PGND, 4=L1, 5=VIN, 6=EN, 7=PS/SYNC, 8=VINA, 9=GND, 10=FB->VOUT, Exposed Pad=PGND).
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.4 verified Abs Max 7.0 V, Rec Op VIN 1.8-5.5 V, TA -40 to 85 C, TJ max 125 C, RthetaJA 46.8 C/W, RthetaJC(top) 62.5 C/W, and RthetaJC(bot) 4.1 C/W.

300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.1 verified Typical Application Schematic (L=2.2 uH, 2x10 uF Cout, VINA 100 Ohm + 0.1 uF filter), up to 96% family efficiency headline, and ~94% TPS63001 peak efficiency at 3.6 V -> 3.3 V.
